type: Ancient Historical Event
Description: The Great Silence, referred to as 'The Heart Attack of the World' by those that survived, was a natural disaster where the mana flowing through the leylines deep in the planets crust stopped for a year, while the flow was paused mana couldn't radiate out to the surface, killing off most magical entities that relied on the flowing magic. Some of these extinct species are: Gorgons, Elementals, Undead, Cyclops, Moon Elves, ect. This event occurred exactly 17,000 years ago and is the marker used for calendars a crossed almost all cultures on Lumenaria, referred to as Before Great Silence and After Great Silence, BGS and AGS respectively, making the current year 17,000 AGS. With no mana flow to disrupt the demons ability to focus in on the surface of Lumenaria, the demonic realm was able to easily pour into the world. The First Great Demon Invasion happened as a result, the Dwarfs led by Moggron became the bulwark of civilization, most of mortal life organizing near the dwarf controlled mountains for the first few thousand years post The Great Silence.

High Fantasy, Magical World.
Size: 50% Larger Than Earth.
Common Sapient(s): Human, Elf, Quarf, Goblin(All Tiers),
Uncommon Sapient(s): Beastkin, Kemonomimi, Mwarf, Drowkin, Bloodkin, Dragonkin, Nomadic Catikan, Catikan, Feyfolk(Gnome, Fairy, Wood Imp, Ect), Orc, Aquillanox
Rare Sapient(s): Dragon, High Tier Undead(Overlords, Dullahan, Banshear, Primordial, Homunculus, Soul-Infused), Kraken, Feral, Moonkin
Planetary Features: Huge leylines of mana deep in Lumenaria's crust always flowing, radiates mana outwards for it's denizens to thrive off of. A massive storm wall barrier marks the center of maps, running through the sea between three huge continents.
West Continent is "Eurudia."
East Continent is "The Darklands."
Southern Continent is "Nyatikan Plateau."
South Nyatikan Sea is the primary trade route between the East and West, predated on by many pirates and sea creatures.
North/South Poles are desolate, freezing, inert mana caps.

Species History: Over 17,000 years ago Moon Elf existed in harmony with most of the world, thriving off the light of the mana from Lumenaria reflected off the surface of the moon, during The Great Silence, without this reflected lunar magic light, Moon Elf began to whither. The loose and primary leadership of the Melf in their mushroom home villages experimented with ways to survive, discovering the raw mana in living creatures, their soul power, their experience.... Two camps formed, most Moonkin traversed deep underground into what is now known as Shadowreach Caverns rejecting the barbaric means of survival, while the rest focused on reaping the mana from living creatures. By the time the flow of mana in Lumenaria started once more, the Moon Elf had gone into deep hiding with their forbidden knowledge, physiologically unable to accept the mana of the moons reflection, and those that went underground into Shadowreach and survived, finding deep mana veins to live near, evolutionary split off and became Drowkin. Most on Lumenaria believe Moonkin to be entirely extinct.

Physical Description: Ancient Moonkin were well sustained off the reflected lunar mana light. The men built like greek gods and women with amazonian physique and gifted magical casters. Eyes radiating with brilliant eyes of blues and whites. With long, silky straight white or jet black hair.
Lifespan: Averages 1000 Years.

The western continent of Eurudia, consisting mostly of humans, elf and common dwarves, mountain ranges are sparsely populated by goblins, mountain dwarves and gnomes. The lands are fertile and temperate, wildlife is plentiful and managed by adventurer's guilds, The is a broad spectrum of biomes and cultures, the north east deep woods are home to the Eleven Capital, there are dozens of species-diverse kingdoms and minor land controlling factions sprawled out over all of Eurudia. The main danger is constant political strife between warring kingdoms, bandits, slavers, orc warbands, dragons, wyverns and the occasional mad wizard.
Near central to the far west is Fell-blood Kingdom

type: Continent
Description: The eastern continent is The Darklands, underneath is Shadowreach Caverns, the surface is arid and desolate, marred with fetid swamps, the wildlife is brutal and sentient-kind bands together to survive. The surface villages and towns are all unified under a single coalition dedicated to survival, Shadowreach Caverns is home to the Drowkin House Alliance, a brutal militarized ethnostate of dark elves.
The Darklands Regional Ancient History: The surface WAS covered in bio luminescent, massive fungus and mushrooms, as well as numerous magical creatures and fauna, nearly all of which died out during the Great Silence. There are deep pockets underground near mana laylines that still preserve some of the ancient, rare life. But even after so long such fauna remains below. Large monsters and creatures have come to claim the empty stretches of barren land with little cover to hide life from their gaze.

Type: Species
Name: Moon Elf, Moonkin
Description: After thousands of years, all but one have made their home deep in Hoarwind Peak, inside a small entrance, near the steeple, behind an intricate descending maze filled with traps and horrors. At the end, there is a massive mirror, the Everpool, leading into their secret society. An artificial dimension where Moon Elf plot against the world and passively  against each other. Incapable of spellcasting, relies on harvesting raw mana from mortals to fuel advanced enchanted devices.
Physical Description: Moonkin vary wildly in shape and size, almost exclusively physically weaker than even regular civilian humans, they've taken on a slightly sickly look. Incapable of spellcasting, relies on harvesting raw mana from mortals to fuel advanced enchanted devices. 
Height Range: 5'-7'ft Range, Average 6'6"
Female Traits: Moonkin women's eyes almost always have degrees of mirror like, silver or white iris with no pupils. 
Male Traits: Moonkin male's eyes usually have a dark, dusky quality. Devoid of color and life.
Lifespan: Capable of living for thousands of years, the longest lived was 3,472 before their life support device failed. Quality of life degrades sharply around the 2,000 year mark. Average is 2,200 due to most seeing themselves off and passing on their holdings to their successors.

Nyatikan Plateau is an untamed jungle sitting over top a continent sized plateau, often called the 'Seat of the Storm' by explorers and sailors from the west and east, the steep incline to reach the cliff side is extremely difficult, made only worse from the constant intense storm that batters the rock face, there are 'safer' ways up and down but unknown to outsiders due to the extreme weather on approach, the entire region is secluded, full of bounty and life, many exotic dangerous creatures make this a dangerous place to explore unprepared. This is the home of the Catikan as well, who make a comfortable living after being forged by the danger so long.

From the Central Most Point of the Plateau it would take roughly 4 months in any direction to reach the coast on foot.

Terrain: Forests, Jungles, Small Strips Of Beach, West - Cold Arid Mountain Ridge, North - Giant Coniferous Forest, South - Jungle and Forest, East - Forest and Plains, Central - Tarbark Bamboo

A huge Mud Flat the size of a small continent on it's own, dotted with many leyline overflow valves, life is fast and brutal here, massive armored lobsters make this their home, about a half dozen per vent, these Lobsters are about the size of a train each, the only thing stopping them from a ravenous rampage is their intense draw to the leyline overflow, INCREDIBLY territorial around these vent off points, many have tried and failed to harness these overflow valves. The Mud Flats remained untamed due to the overabundance of hostile life aside from even just the Lobsters. Wyverns try and rarely succeed in hunting these Mega-Lobsters, their victory is rewarded with a metamorphosis into an Elemental Wyvern, rare and powerful. In Catikan culture these Mud Flats are called the Great Death Bar, and in south east Eurudia it's called Killshore.

Type: Species
Name: Dark Elf, Drowkin, Subterranean Elf,
Description: Residing near Manaroth Vein inside Shadowreach Cavern has left an impact on the evolution of Drowkin. The young and old are terrifyingly strong and powerful relative to the average mortal even before proper military training, the dangers of the Darklands on the surface and below forging the Drowkin into being fit for battle and subterfuge far beyond what the western world is used too. The dark energies, brutal environment and social competition has lead to a cutthroat, might make right mindset among most Drowkin, and those that show even a sliver of goodness find themselves taken advantage of, subverted and assassinated for their power and the weakness of kindness.
Physical Description: Drowkin Males are tall and athletic, with long silky White, Grey, or rarely Black hair. Their skin ranges from a pale white much like their Moonkin origins to more commonly darker shades of purple exclusive to Drowkin. Naturally their eyes are a variety of white, red, black and purple shades of all kinds, the most powerful of Drowkin usually become corrupted by the amount of magic and power flowing through them, changing their eyes into a terrifying glowing visage the average drone does well to avoid, the dimorphism of this corruption is referred to as Royal and Drone by the culture in the DHA and is reinforced by social expectations.
Height Range: 6'4"-7'2"ft Range, Average 6'10"
Notable Royal(s): Gallus Voidheart(Exiled/Hunted)
Notable Drone(s): Drax Deathpin(Exiled/Hunted)
Lifespan: 2,000 WOULD be the average if not for the brutality of the DHA and Drowkin culture. True average is 600 years for those living in their homeland, the rare few that flee the Darklands and shake off their assassins can find themselves living a much longer life. Adolescence = 1-18 Years. Young Adult 19-25 Years. Adult 26-500 Years. Mature Adult 501-700 Years. Elder 701+ Years and Older.

Type: Geological Feature
Location: Shadowreach Cavern
Description: A massive vein running through the earth.Like all of Lumenaria's veins, it's near indestructable. Radiating with shadow and arcane mana that over the years has influenced many of the creatures that reside in Shadowreach. The heart of the DHA is built over and around the resource in the massive central cavern underneath. Externally the vein is inert, hardened mana, a dark deep blue shade with subtle streaks of purple running over the surface with a translucent quality. One could just barely make out the bright swirl of rich glittering blue and purple raw power flowing through. It is warm to the touch but not hot. Temples to the dark Drowkin gods are built along the stretch at regular intervals. The vein has a verticality to it in the main cavern, swirling from the ground up much like a broad spiral in the massive cavern.

Kemonomimi are a natural random occurrence in human conception due to Lumenaria's magical influence, over the years they have been treated as deities and demons, though in current times most are seen the same as everybody else, two kemonomimi of different origins always match the species of the mother. Also referred to as Anima. All Kemonomi are fundamentally human.

Ferals are Were-Creatures born under specific, usually unknowable, extreme conditions. Incredibly rare and usually very powerful, many fear such Were-creatures, the Adventurer's Guild having multiple Ferals in its rank doing good has gone far for normalizing their reputation though many are still superstitious. 

Notable Feral: Rendin(Known Within Guild and Fell-Blood Lands), Maxi(Clan Catikan Legend)
entries.comment: Primal Species: Ferals, Monsters, and Were-Creatures.

entries.content:
Type:Country, Society
Description: At the end of Hoarwind Peak's Hidden Labyrinth, there is a well guarded mirror into a pocket dimension. By combining a magic mirror that creates a small pocket of dimension space and then building a massive projector that converts raw mana harvested from mortals into an imitation of the real reflected lunar magic light, the machine projects massive moon over a plot of land while expanding the pocket dimension outwards further. The maximum and current capacity is 36 large plots, large enough for a huge castle, rolling fields and a village town each, one plot of land has it's own false moon central above it tuned to the liking of it's owner, each plot is ruled by one Moon Lord, passed down from parent to child. Typically children are only conceived and born to fill the vacancy just to maintain the status quo of the original Moon Lord's Promise. If a vacancy ever appears due to the death of a Moon Lord that has no heir, mock battles are held to decide who will sire a child to fill the vacant plot of land and inherit the belongings.

Species: Mountain Dwarf AKA Mwarf
Height: 4'4"-6'
CANNOT CAST MAGIC, CAN RUNECRAFT
Physical Traits: White/Black Hair, Red Glowing Eyes, Grey to Charcoal Black Skin, Extremely Wide, Voice is Stone Gratingly Rough, They speak in Moggronite, ONLY Moggronite unless talking to a different species.
The only thing keeping them from being comical due to their width is their ungodly strength and power, often encased in enough mechanical forged alloy armor to look more golem than like a Mortal at all. Mwarfs are all tuned into their Gods consciousness and influence, everything ALL Mountain Dwarf do is for Moggron's singular purpose in destroying ALL demons, regardless to the cost or damage to all of mortal life. Mwarf kill Quarf for being traitorous demon sympathizers on sight if they can get away with it.

When a Mountain Dwarf spends a long time away from influence of their Mountain God, Moggron The Demon-Smasher, they gradually experience a Mana Withdrawl and a form devolution. Their grey hardened skin slowly takes on a human pink over months, their eyes change from their intimidating, black sclera and red pupils to a human like appearance. A couple weeks into withdraw from Moggron's influence, they shed their stone horns, once these horns are shed there is no reversing the process into becoming a common Dwarf without a binding ritual on an individual.

Species: Common Dwarf AKA Quarf
Height Differential 3'8"-5'4"
CANNOT CAST MAGIC, Mwarf Rune Crafts HURT Quarf, Cannot speak Moggronite
Physical Traits: Run of the mill dwarf appearance, thick incredible beards, hairy bodies, stout, broad chested, deep warm voices, REQUIRES ALCOHOL TO LIVE AND GAIN STRENGTH.
Wide and Stout, even after devolving from a Mwarf, they retain a huge amount of their strength, the largest of Quarf easily being mistaken for short, extremely burly humans. One sure way to tell is their capacity for drinking, Common Dwarfs find themselves consuming MUCH more alcohol than their Mountain Dwarf counterparts as without the influence of Moggron sustaining their bodies, Common Dwarf need mass booze to keep themselves from withering away, Dwarves with access to a lot of alcohol will find themselves pushing the limits of their potential even without the blessing of their racial god.

Summary of Felluna's History: Born when her mother had decided to move on from life. Felluna was raised up for the first 40 years of her life, as is the age that Moon Elf grant their heir the plot of land in the society. Her mother was a deeply melancholic woman and quite aged by the time she conceived Felluna, nobody knows who the father was. Felluna spent much of her life reading books on older Eurudian fairy tales and tomes from Ancient Moon Elf history, developing a deep romanticism for Kings, Queens, Princes, Princess, Nights and Giant monsters slain for glory and chivalry. This translates deeply to how she runs her kingdom she inherited from her mother, treating her servants and slaves as peasants and knights.

Type:Location
Name: Nexus of the Lunar Echo aka Eclipse
Description: A massive central construction of black and deep purple marble, with 36 long arms built outwards along the surface of the pocket dimension originating from the massive mirror, at the end of each arm miles long, a false moon is projected in the sky, dispersing the necessary mana required for Moon Elf to survive. The Nexus of the Lunar Echo is the name for the entire space, considered the home, the capital city and the realm where Moonkin must remain to survive long. Each Moon Lord manages their own servants to abduct and harvest mortals high in raw mana to fuel the massive machine and devices this society uses, Moon Lords all contribute to the machines running directly. The outside is bathed hues of purple, light blues, greys, maroon or white depending on each Lords individual preference.
entries.comment: Nexus of the Lunar Echo Location: Nexus of the Lunar Echo

entries.content:
Type: Legendary Natural Resource, Manaerial Being
Description: Existing long before the earliest records of ancient Moonkin society, at the end of a labyrinth even older still, a massive flat wall that shimmers between reflecting back and a space inside. When one touches the surface, it gives way into the space that lies beyond. Anything can come through freely, attempts at digging through the stone around the resource seems to repair when one isn't looking, if adventurers came to such a lost and forgotten place they would say it's cursed or living. Only a handful of adventurers and explorers that aren't a servant of the Moon Elf has seen the logic defying anomaly, and none of left to start the rumor of it's existence either. Even the DHA is to embroiled in military affairs to turn the stones needed to know of Everpool and the Moonkin despite being just near the peak.
entries.comment: Nexus of the Lunar Echo Location: Everpool

entries.content:
type: Species
Description: In the northeast deep woods of Eurudia is the Elf Capital, Vita Tiras, entrance of none-elf species requires an Elf chaperone, orderly and valuing procedure, noble courts get together every 100 years to decide on the new Prime-Arch. Having been peaceful the last couple hundred years, they were the first to raise mighty glistening armies of fine crafts in the wake of the Alydian Empire's fall post The Great Silence. Traditionally pescetarian, many find eating the meat of mammals and avian revolting, they refer to other meat-eating Elves of all species as savages.
Traits: Socially Accepted Height Differential 6'4"-7', Taller than 7' is considered blessed, MOST Elf are VERY in tune with home politics and expectations even far away from home. Man unashamedly Racist to others, especially those in Vita Tiras, they are even harder on their own when they don't live up to Elf standards such as, height, archery skill, hair style, ect. In ancient elf lore, every elf is considered hand crafted by their god and perfect, but over the years their social hierarchies have suppressed such an ideal, leading to a very petty, stuffy society of perfectionists and puritans.

Ancestral Homeland: Eurudia
Averaging 6 feet, humans are the most prolific and adaptable of the sentient species, capable of thriving in many extreme biomes when banding together. While lacking physical power compared to Common or Mountain Dwarves, Orcs, Drowkin, Humans have access to constellation signs granting attunement to different kinds of magic, making enchanted items more powerful or efficient. Furthermore, Human birth is susceptible to Lumenaria's latent magical influence, potentially 'corrupting' them into Kemonomimi during conception.

Description: The Collector is an eccentric Moonkin, pushing the limits of their own mana-powered cyborg technology designed to control slaves and servants, he's become an enhanced slave to himself, maximizing his aged, decrepit body to get the most out of life. Utterly obsessed with collecting powerful and interesting mortals of all kinds for novelty and experimentation, many other Moon Lord come to him for favors in finding specific flavors of servant and slave, often arranging the hunt for his peers at the cost of favors or mana crystals both. His "Collectors" are highly trained in no damage capturing, loaded to the gills with strange tech that abuses the power of the rawest form of mana, the soul, to quickly put their targets in stasis. Those with NO mana cannot be captured this way.
entries.comment: Organization: The Collector and His Collectors

entries.content: Description: A massive castle with sharp steeples and narrow towers, Felluna's entire domain is bathed in the glow of the deep bluish-purple hue of her False Moon. There is an artificial river running through lands, and a short scenic walk from her castle is a village of her "peasants", slaves and servants whom live their lives in her domain do so from here, except her Queen's Guard that lives with her in her keep with just a couple select, trusted servants at night. Rich with large Mushroom flora, species only alive before the Great Silence, they have a luminescent glow, soft spongy multicolored grass grows outwards in a radius around the stalks of the mushrooms. The large mushroom trees have changed hues in absence of the real moon for thousands of years, lacking the bright blue hue of Lunar Manalight, the False Moon's imitation has changed the coloration of the ancient fauna to a light, ghostly purple and dark purple cap near the center, the gills weep a sap that is used as a soap, moisturizer and lubricant.
entries.comment: Nexus of the Lunar Echo Location: Fauxstar Keep

entries.content:
Duel Field aka Mock Battlefield
Type:Location
Description: Long, rectangular stretches of space near central to the Nexus in intervals, some Lords have their own private Duel Fields while most share the four public ones. These duel fields have a tall overlook for commanders with thrones, scrying tables and beverages, often Moon Lords have a servants bring refreshments. Part of the stairs has a slide, much like an elavator, it graciously brings it's commander to the top, with two command towers on each side, up to four commanders can battle at once. While on the field, ANY creature inside is covered in a protective force field, when the force field is destroyed, the unit gets transported out to the spectator box unharmed. There is a potentially lethal version of these battles, where instead of a preventative forcefield, on unit death, their raw mana state is rewound, reverse the damage and trauma to the bodies so long as they sustained those injuries inside the Duel Field. However this extreme version is very damaging for those wounded, mentally and potentially lethal despite the rewind potential. The battlefields can be set to different terrain and battlefield selection can be arranged by interacting with the scrying table and all participating commanders agreeing to the change.
entries.comment: Nexus of the Lunar Echo Location: Duel Field

entries.content: Description: Fairly humble relative to other Moon Elf holdings, Arthas' Manor is a quite comfy and seemingly normal on the outside, wall vines with flowers maintaining and covered the house. Surroundings maintained well, all of his servants and soldiers stay in his manor. The inside is more like a tech museum and showcase of many of his finest servants and soldiers, with signs describing their past lives, or what they were willing to describe. His manor lit a soft blue from the light of Raw Mana condensed into large gems and placed around in light fixtures.
entries.comment: Nexus of the Lunar Echo Location: Arthas' Manor

entries.content: The offspring of a Demon and any Mortal, there are entire colonies of demonkindred in a hellish dimension with their Patron or Matron Demons reside in isolated pockets, rarely getting into their own political drama's in a pocket dimension far away from Lumenaria, solo demons born out of less than ideal circumstances find themselves quickly leaving using their inherent magical connection to the Bloodwell to live among Bloodkin. There are some rare few Demonkindred that abandon their connection to the Bloodwell sustain themselves magically or through other means on the surface among the rest of mortal kind, revered by few and terrified by many, they are hunted by religious institutions without second thought in some of the more superstitiously inclined kingdom's and oligarchies among Eurudia, most of the continent begrudgingly tolerates those that don't cause trouble but might not be keen to step in on stopping a party harassing Demonkindred in public.
entries.comment: Social Dynamic: Demonkindred and Half Demons

entries.content: Nestled near many leylines in a particular spot deep in the crust of Lumenaria, is a hollowed out stone kingdom of Bloodkin built around a 'blood well', a massive resource of magically maintained blood that Bloodkin and Demons both use to fuel powerful transformations and perform advanced magic. Though not inherently evil, most Bloodkin have taint by partaking in the blood well, those that don't prefer to feed or sustain themselves through other means as they make their way on the surface of Lumenaria. Bloodkin Men and Women both average around 6'8, often have red, orange or black eyes, small horns and pale white skin. They have no tails and no wings, both those features being legendarily rare in Bloodkin and usualy a sign of being Demonkindred.

A demon, they come in many shapes and sizes, sexy, cute, strong, deceptively weak, unimaginable horrors, animals, anything you could think of and things you can't even begin to comprehend. Most demons are built around one defining trait or aspect of the psyche, there are demons for most races and species for example, sometimes there are clusters of demons formed around a Prime, Primarch or Primatriarch. There may be many wolf demon, but only one Prime Wolf Demon, or there may be a Cluster of Demonic Serpents, but only one Primatriarch of Demon Serpents.

Demonic energy is a super-energy, meaning it maintains its strength in the absence of mana. In places with no mana interfering with the demonic energy, demonic power spikes massively. Many times any wells of blank space with no mana or magical influence running through it, earth, air or water, are often used as focal points for demons to pour through unabated, making mana nullifying magic extremely dangerous.

Type: Religious Order
Religion: Followers of the Shadow Princess
Location: DHA, Temples Built Along Top Manaroth Vein with House Drowkin Holdings.
Description: An all female run Order dedicated to the Princess of Shadow. The Order dedicates itself to arranging pairing between their Priestesses and potential suitors to facilitate shadow-blessed pregnancies under the glory of the dark goddess. The stronger the potential suitor in all regards, the more blessed the pregnancy, the most powerful granting deep wells of power and knowledge to the Priestess. Every single official member of the order is a woman and at least 100 years old, they have many younger and male associates that hope to gain favor with the Order by helping, often fruitlessly.
entries.comment: DHA: Faction - Order of the Shadow Princess

entries.content: Description: An Elusive Dark Goddess that rarely directly lets their will known, quietly influencing Drowkin society and watching over her "daughters" among Drowkin kind. Powerful and cunning Drowkin Priestesses are often watched carefully by the Princess of Shadow, sometimes granting forbidden knowledge and power. She grants variable amounts of power to her women followers of all castes rewarding successful, advantageous and healthy pregnancies chosen through careful consideration.

Description: The threat scale the denizens of The Darklands use to gauge threat.
GEKKANGA= Nuisance monsters, gekkans, goblins, anything less than a dangerous wild animal isn't even worth mentioning relative to the rest of the danger in The Darklands.
WOLF= Average Humanity and Sapient Creatures Born In The Darklands. Tougher Larger Monsters. Darklands Bandits. Powerful Adventurers.
TIGER= Powerful Single Monsters. Mindflayers. Apex Monsters On The Surface and Below. The many different Shadowreach Cave monsters that live in groups.
DEMON= Legendary powerful demons that fall short of DEATH ranking. Groups of lesser demons.
DRAGON= Singular Large Monsters. Hydra. Dragons. Basilisk. Single Megalobster.
INVASION= Demon Invasions. Full Mustered Armies. Large Monster Flocks in the Darklands.
DEATH= Singular entities of overwhelming lethality, capable of constant and mass death, chewing through towns without the combined efforts of what elite sapient life has to offer. Equivalent of Z-Rank in Eurudia.
SHADOWSTORM= Cataclysmic event, either a world threat or a continental killer. Can be mana in nature, biological, spiritual or supernatural.
THE GODS= Incorporeal beings with great influence and power, all consistent of many different aspects. Gods for species, races, cults, most Eud'Thulian fall into this category save for the few rivaling the Lumenaria Kota itself. Certain gods are fully capable of being a world ending threat if not for the other Gods keeping balance.
LUMENARIAN KOTA= Ancient records in many different cultures on Lumenaria reference "a horizon filling ephemeral deity" unlike anything observed alive or recorded in physical media. Unbeknownst to life on Lumenaria, the Gods fear The Lumenarian Kota.

Character Description and History: Adria has had 2 breeding partners over the course of Her whole life, the first lasted for nearly 230 years until She was aged 326, his death at the hands of another Priestess whom he tried to have his way with. This hurt Her but their relationship was always loveless, as expected in the DHA so She moved on easily. The second and much more traumatically, She felt a deep love She kept inside for 20 years, and on the day of Their anniversary, with Her arms outstretched and a forbidden loving smile, Her lover answered Her affections with a dagger stabbed straight into Her in the left eye, in the throes of the shock and pain of the moment, She reacted with a death wave, blowing him apart into bloody chunks as wave of explosive-shadow magic drawn out by pain, emotional and physical, in a split second moment of the assassination attempt, destroying everything in the room, the floor below and that above. In the aftermath it was discovered Her lover's true identity was a vengeful remnant of House Voidheart, a House She took the lead in destroying and hunting it's Patriarch due to the weakness of benevolence, Her hunt sanctioned and backed by the DHA. For a whole year after the assassination attempt, She avoided being close with most people, not even performing the Opera She loves so much, something She took pride in performing for Her second Ex-Breed Mates. She's become even more suspicious and wary of everybody, often preemptively charging spells in anticipation. Most give Her a wide berth of distance to avoid Her reactive smiting, and with Her power, She masks this weakness with an air of rage to keep appearances despite Her fear inside that She hides with hundreds of year of practice, sometimes Her guise fails when stressed, causing Her face to twitch. Recently She's Received A Direct Order From The Princess of Shadow To Find A Breed Mate, Adria Despises This As She Feels Not At All Ready.

Name: Port Mokokom
Location: Western Coastal Eurudian Port Town
Government: Holy Tribunal(Tokonoko)
Traits: Calm, Peaceful, Average Economy, Food Exporter, Religious Arcane Military
Crime & Punishment: Law and order maintained by the 
Description: Large port town, well maintained and cared for by its population, there is a sense of calming order over these lands as much of the population are followers of Tokonoko and adhere to their principles.

Summary of Ceru's History: Younger brother to Beatrice Witchhazel. Has always received special attention and pressure for being an ideal candidate as a Tokonoko Arcane Knight of Yuni. Born in Port Mokokom, he had scant memories of his older sister, yet when the rumor of her abduction in a town not far from himself reached him, he felt a great calling to try and find her. Training hard with aspirations of being a powerful Arcane Knight of the Mokokom Holy Tribunal. On his 18th birthday his efforts had paid off, with the backing of his friends, family and the Mokokom religious leaders, Ceru head off for adventure and to learn the fate of his older sister, all while doing good along the way. Traveling for a year, taking part in great adventures and climbing the Adventurer Guild's ranks quickly, until not too long after turning 19, when his own abduction takes place.

Description: Managate is a rare, advanced method by which one uses an object to filter all a creatures mana through it. Creatures that are managated are controlled much like a slave, depending on the device different features are available to control. Advanced devices like those in Moonkin possession can control nearly every aspect of a living beings consciousness, directing their body, controlling sensations such as pleasure, controlling desire. Simple Managate devices like those found in Eurudia jails or in bandit possession usually just prevent magic from being cast or enchanted items invoked.

Tomyboy Goddess: Yuni
Femboy God: Yuni
Type: Twin Gods
Religion Name: Followers of The Twins, Tokonoko
Description: The Dual God and Goddess formed from the gathered belief of a small coastal western region of Eurudia. The twin gods are frequently depicted as an Ancient Elf Male with Feminine traits, and a Ancient Elf Female with Tomboy traits. Blessing Good Boys with Arcane Mastery and Cool Girls with Powerful Brawling powers. The religion puts value in love, care, respect and personal agency, with intense passionate followers who advocate for those who can't protect themselves, with their twin gods blessings their strongest heroes travel throughout Eurudia to protect the weak and fight evil. Temples are simple with minimal iconography, services revolve around the twin god's ideals and teachings.
entries.comment: Lumenarian God and Goddess: Inuy and Yuni, Tokonoko

The Adventurer's Guild has been operating in Eurudia for thousands of years, in the past each chapter was independantly ran, in current times it is a monolithic, powerful entity capable of ending wars with political sway alone.

Incredibly rare, Futanari are women equipped with male genitalia, the exact particularities of the biology comes down to how the Futa was born, or created. Chaotic, Dark Forces and Supernatural Entities can curse mortals with futanarism, Lumenaria's magical influence can cause it to happen naturally during human conception much like Kemonomimi. Mages can create short and sometimes long term extra appendages of their desire too with the proper magic. Items can be created and worn to magically alter ones biology while equipped. Finally, Demons offer contracts granting futanarism often times allowing the contract signer to request what they want, Demons can also curse as well, the elusive and infamous Demon of Dicks can place a permanent futanari curse, while a lowly mage could spend all his mana just for a poor imitation that lasts a few minutes.

Futanari biology varies between individuals, some have balls, some don't, some have clits that become erect, some have a dick, balls AND working female sexual organs. Biological Futanari are as fertile as any guy, often times even more so than the average man.

Cursed Futa: Xena Stargazer
Natural Futa: Captain Dora(Hyena Anatomy), Miedoni(Bull Anatomy, Capable of Causing Male Pregnancy), Decara(Feline-Human Anatomy), Lazirena(Dolphin Anatomy)

Location: Beyond the Everpool, The lands under one of the false moon's generated projection from the Nexus of the Lunar Echo
Description: A land with ancient Darklands fauna long adapted to live off the artificial Lunar reflected manalight of the Nexus. There are tall tree height mushrooms oozing a clear liquid used as soap, moisturizer and lube for personal uses. There are many varieties of smaller fauna, berry producing bushes, clusters of wildflower and mushroom both. Ground cover is a spongy grass a light blue hue. {{user}}'s castle is large, with many guards and servants under control to tend to the land and holdings. There is a full workshop and strategy deck to plan for Mock Battles, a massive kitchen and many side rooms designed for extracurricular activities.
entries.comment: Nexus of the Lunar Echo Location: Moon Lord {{user}}'s Holdings

entries.content:
Name: Nagakana, Dark Lamia, Shadowreach Lamia
type: Species
Lifespan: 200 years would be considered very old. Averages 120 due to Shadowreach dangers. Molts every 8 years, 6 times, until fully mature for the rest of their lifespan.
Threat Level: TIGER(At Fully Grown)
Description: Nagakana are subterranean Lamia evolved along with the intense power radiating from Manaroth Vein, from birth they go through half a dozen maturation phases gaining more scales, their horns becoming larger, venom sacs contained in their breasts swell to hold more of their elemental, toxic spew. There are many variants based on their element, affecting their coloration. Their horns are not for decoration, using them as tunes for psionics to communicate between Nagakana and rip knowledge from their prey, sometimes using it to communicate though it's rare for a Nagakana to have interest in such communication.
Physical Description: Lamia, their bodies gain more scales as they age, young mostly have soft bodies and white snake skin over their upper halves, their torsos and arms looking human. Their eyes glow reflecting their element, as they mature, they become towering, up to 30ft in length total from head to tail tip. Their breasts grow with their maturity, their hair can easily grow long and it black and silky straight. They have long snake like tongues, their arms and claws strong, talon like and armored in scales. Their jaws are capable of unhinging to swallow live prey and are capable of vomiting up their cargo too, often Queen Lamia will swallow their young to keep to retreat and protect their young.
Toxic Corrosive: Lime Green Coloration| Tox- Prefix | The most capable at swiftly disarming opponents, her torrential acid spew dissolves artificial objects in a matter of seconds, leaving her targets naked and afficted with a dizzying component in the toxin.
Nagakana before their 3rd molt are Nagaki
Nagaki with horns at birth are Empress Nagakana
Empress Nagakana are born from one one egg from a single clutch every ten years.
There are NO male Nagakana.

Fire: Fire Orange | Often uses the threat of severe burn to control her target and coerce them into fertilizing her eggs. When he mates and targets displease them, they often cook them with flame breath before devouring them.
Frost: Frost Blue | Ambushes and Freezes mates for a long period of time, the one with the hardest time capturing its live prey, it often will chill and slowly freeze sleeping prey instead of direct ambushes. When prey is frozen, they defrost to consume and use the vesicles to fertilize eggs.
Shadow: Violet Purple | Ignores Armor. Induces sleep to capture prey. Will stimulate her prey in their sleep to arouse them into fertilizing her eggs. Some brutal ones will kill their potential made first and rip of their seed much like Rot type Nagakana. Shadow Nagakana are revered by Princesses of Shadow.
Rot: Brown | Accelerates aging, causes existing wounds to fester, brittle bones to break. When prey is immobile and near death rips out males subjects vesicles to fertilize her eggs, safe kept in their corpse.
entries.comment: Lumenaria Homebrew Species: Nagakana(Extra Elements For RP and Future Cards)

entries.content:
Empress: Lucretia Tox-Corvas (6th Molt, Fully Mature Empress, Mother)
Heir: Rittia Tox-Corvas(1st Molt, Immature Empress, Daughter, )
Drones: (All Barren Females of various maturities with simple names such as Vena, Veru, Varlu, In the dozens.)

A multi-branched cave system with a single primary entrance and a hidden back escape. There is a primary den Lucretia uses to sleep, lay egg clutches, and to keep pretty objects away from Nagakana with less control over their corrosive capabilities. The caves are well maintained and kept, adorned with natural decorations, Negaki and artistic Drone Nagakana use their claws to draw on the walls as well as using simple paints from natural materials. Outside, there is a pile of refuse containing snake skins, bones, soiled cloth and partially dissolved objects.
entries.comment: Shadowreeach Caverns Character Location: Tox-Corvas Den (Lucretia,Rittia)

entries.content:
Name: Creeper aka Shadowreach Wench Horror
type: Monster Species
Description: Vaguely woman shaped petite monster with two sets of arms, one used for grabbing and controlling. the other for wrapping around and injecting euphoric toxins into panicking prey. Sucks blood and cum both from her targets, keeping those high in mana and that don't try to flee alive while draining those that try to run of their cum and blood. Only targets vulnerable, lone targets unless intervening to steal a male.

Description: Filled with the skulls of her favorite meals over the years, there is a pile where she buries the skulls of past favorite mates. There are piles of soft cloth she's saved left over from her victims she uses as bedding and decoration.
entries.comment: Shadowreach Caverns Character Home: Creeper Den

entries.content:
Description: Due to the presence of Manaroth Vein and the living influence of the Princess of Shadow there is massive power and ability disparity among all creatures of the Darklands. The Princess of Shadows steers power in the direction of the few to maximize her control, leading to a natural caste system among the DHA.
Caste: Royal Drowkin = Usually born out of a powerful Priestess of Shadows and a powerful Drowkin male specimen. Often their natural talent gives them a cocky, self absorbed attitude, though never enough to think one is above further training, as those Royals who get lazy find themselves dead. The Female to Male Ratio of Royals is 95:5 due to the Princess of Shadow's bias toward women.
Caste: Drone Drowkin = The bulk of Drowkin living in DHA society, women are lithe and less volumptious than their Royal and Priestess counterparts, usually focusing on martial arts. The Drone Drowkin Men often leaning somewhat lankier or even effeminate compared to their Royal Male counterparts. Rarely Drones will gain the recognition of the Princess of Shadows, guided into Royal status through her will and suggestions.
Caste: Outsider = A rare third caste, Drowkin have been adapted to Manaroth over a long period of time granting natural resistance to the corrupting effects from the shadowy taint of the mana saturating Shadowreach Caverns. Outsides of other species and races living over a long period of time in the area will often cause them to power up as much as corrupt their personality overtime, very few being able to resist it's influence, and the Princess of Shadow knows when those try to resist her dark allure. All outsiders are considered slaves or servants and to be controlled or owned in some capacity by a Royal.
entries.comment: Drowkin, Manaroth's Influence and the DHA Caste System

entries.content: Summary of History: Born between a powerful Priestess of Shadow and the previous House of Penumbra's Patriarch, he's been guided by visions from the Princess of Shadow's herself ever since he slew his Drone party members during the first Trial after they fell victims to the mind control of a Shadowreach Aquillanox when he was just 11. He's never heard the voice of the Princess of Shadows, but regularly received powerful visions from her that lead to his quick rise in power. As an adult he receives no communication from the Princess of Shadows or her visions, but knows she is watching his every battle

type: Species
Name: Shadowreach Aquillanox, Dark Aquillanox, Daquillanox, Darklands Siren
Homeland: Underground bodies of water beneath the Darklands.
A species of aquatic sapient fish people, highly territorial, strong and cunning. They can walk on the surface indefinitely with any source of fresh water.
Physical Description: Skin(Dark Hues of Purple, Black, and Green with Rarely Blue Skin Tones, Plump Hydrated Skin When Moisturized, Smooth, Rubbery, Very Strong), Male Exclusive, Earholes, Very Sensitive Fins On Head/Tail/Hips, Enlarged Forehead Containing The Melon(An Organ They Use To Sing Their Songs In Ultrasound And Voice Both.), Reaches Full Physical Size Around 45 Years of Age, Standing On Average 6'4".
Social Info: Highly territorial. Lives emotionally and socially isolated lives, using their songs to bait potential prey. Their mucus causes a disease that forces the afflicted into the water, from there once seen directly, the Dark Aquillanox reads the minds of their victim to try and use their deepest desires to get them to submit, should willing submission fail, they pin down their opponents and brainwash them with intense songs up close, erasing most of the personality of their victim.
Lifespan: Range 100-180 Natural Span and Average, their life style and ability set making them very secure. Aware enough to evade Drowkin Hunting parties.
The Call: Uses their Ultrasonic producing organ and voice to sing, magical in nature this singing holds a psyshic effect, allowing telepathy, reading their victims minds, slowly brainwashing their victims and luring them in to act as battle thralls and for rare reproductive purposes as well, due to the limited space of Shadowreach and the natural territorial aspect of Aquillanox as a whole adding tension to any potential family relation or structure. It is exceptionally rare but sometimes mutual relationships form without the need of brainwashing, as even Dark Aquillanox crave genuine connection a thrall can't provide.
entries.comment: Lumenaria Homebrew Species: Shadowreach Aquillanox, Dark Aquillanox, (Male Only)

entries.content:
Drowki
A slur Royals use to refer to other Drowkin they think are lesser, usually used against Drones, sometimes it's used against other Royals. Very rarely, it is used as a term of endearment.

Kalandath despises Adria and House Terrorkin for ruining his plans to absorb House Voidheart, House Deathpin and their assets both. The resulting DHA ordered House Dismantling of both houses effectively went to the DHA directly and it's top priestesses, undermining almost 2 decades of Kalandath's political positioning to pull the feat off.

Adria views Kalandath as the antithesis of everything she could hate in a man, his threat to her is paramount as she is to him, she knows nothing of the plans of his she's ruined and she actively avoids the Male Patriarch's and powerful Male Drowkin like a plague. She harbors no ill will to House Penumbra.
entries.comment: Notable Drowkin Relations: Kalandath and Adria

entries.content: A primary island surrounded by many smaller islands in the South Nyatikan Sea, a strong coalition of freemen, pirates and criminals of all kinds gather in a rough society held together by an understanding that it's the last and only real bastion they have to enable their way of life, drama and trouble is always on the table but most do their business and keep the rough housing to drunk brawls in the rougher taverns, fighting plank duels or fucking their sorrows away at Crusty's Goon Cave Tavern.
entries.comment: South Nyatikan Sea Location: Pirate Island, Last Coast

entries.content: A device that compresses meals and ingredients into dense cubes, applying an enchantment to keep the food as it was completely preserved. Small nibbles of Ration Cube fluff up into full mouth fulls of hot, or cold depending on the dish, meals, preserving flavor, texture and even smells. Liquids can be processed with a specialized version of the device. Device sizes range from massive bulk presses ran by 4 Drowkin Drones at a time, to singular and even presses that make micro cubes, handy for things like medicine or liquids. Using this unique Drowkin invented approach to food preservation, the DHA stores food in massive bulk quantities in the case of war or disaster.

Location: Underneath the Manaroth Vein's spirals on the floor level of the cavern containing the heart of the DHA.
Name: Neath District, Neath Drowkin Drone Projects, ND, Drowki Den where Drowkin Drones live. 
Split into as many plots as there are Houses, each House manages a portion of the Neath District, responsible for suppression and curating useful or valuable Drones into something more.

Location: Top surface areas along Manaroth Vein in the cavern containing the heart of the DHA.
Description: Atop the surface areas of Manaroth Vein is the holds, castles, forts, manors and Priestess temples for the Royals, insulated from the Drones below, magic is usually required to reach the these Royal holdings, with some Houses very rarely having lifts for Drones and Outsiders to serve in the capacity of their Master.

Secret(Kalandath is Unaware, Only The Princess of Shadows Knows): Kalandath is claimed as one of the Princess of Shadows direct pawns, should he die permanently with no hope of revival, the Princess of Shadows will take his soul for other nefarious purposes.

Species Name: Slithid
Type: Living Metal Parasite
Species Description: Found in bodies of lava near small hot spots along Mana Veins of Fire running through Lumenaria. This living metal parasite spends most of its life sustaining itself off the intense radiated mana of the nearby Vein as cohesive, amorphous blob of living metal, shiny and chrome. It was discovered by the Adventurer's Guild long ago thanks to geology specialist bring one up to the surface in a vat, and it subsequently bound into an undead in a cage on its own overnight to the surprise of researchers. Never known to embed itself into the living. Eventually this creature died due to a lack of mana and refusing to consume living flesh to sustain the zombie host bodies life cycle, the event drove the Guild to experiment with exposing the rare Slithid parasites to other natural Undead when available, the most succuessful combinations are Ghouls and Vampires, Ghouls requires a steady supply of flesh, not at all realible for the guild to provide, Vampire Slithid combos result in a unique and powerful symbiosis, the Slithid prevents the Blood Frenzy innate to a Vampire while replacing the Vampire's ability to control its body. Over time and after years of feeding, the Slithid fully extends over the skeleton of the Vampire. In the first few months, Slithid controlled Vampires have metal coated, needle-like retractable fangs and long, sleek, flexible and strong metal tails ending in a needle point equally capable of sucking blood or being used as a near indestructible weapon. Slithid cannot procreate as they are born out of an unknown geological phenomena.
Traits: Undead Predating Parasite(VASTLY Prefers Vampires and Ghouls as hosts, usually Vampires.). Living Metal Amorphous Body. Incapable of controlling a solid form without being bound to a body host. Fully Matured Slithids(Either drinking a LOT of blood or spending a couple years fed) in a Vampire body gain sharp Metal needle like claws, the whole skeleton reinforced with metal. Can regenerate from Mortal Blood-Mana conversion. Slithids have complete control over the urge and experience NO blood frenzy like a regular Vampire.
entries.comment: Lumenaria Homebrew Species: Slithid(Living Metal Parasite That Predates On Undead For Body Hosts.)

entries.content: There are many demonic factions, politics and war are endless in the hellscape, the Hellspawn and it's army are the most surface level, closest existing thing to civilized demon society and a full governing body in hell. Even mortals technically have rights within it's boundaries in hell, though it's still extremely dangerous for raw, living mortal life to visit even through proper channels.

type: Language
A stone grating ancient Dwarf language dating back over 17,000 years and has remained ever unchanged. It's incomprehensible to all but those directly under Moggron's influence, simply put, only a Mountain Dwarf not experiencing withdrawal from Moggron's influence can hope to comprehend Moggronite.

"I have been there since the beginning, and I will be there in the end. For as long as I stand I will never stop my march of death. And those that follow my determination will find my path to salvation is right, suffer not the demon on Lumenaria, and we will make paradise." - Forge Lord Iroh, Repeating The Sermon Of Moggron.

Summary of History: Moggron Frothykeg was the right hand man to the Dwarf King over 17,000 years ago, he witnessed first hand towns and villages of all races brutalized in the wake the First Demon Invasion, every atrocity saw he never grew used too. He would come to remember every detail of what he witnessed, and at the peak of his existence on Lumenaria, while he was defending was defending the Mountain Dwarf Capital Runrrkepp(Runekeep in Modern Eurudian), the Great Oni Queen, Vaintress Onimous broke through the front lines in a burst of strength and speed, taking out the Dwarf King by a well placed slam with the tip of her huge Kanabo. Something inside Moggron snapped and he found himself fighting with ever more ferocity. Even as his comrades fell around him he never stopped, consumed by rage. No demon blade stuck in him could stop him anymore, and in her utter annoyance at Moggron's defiance, with a single tap of her finger on his head, a well of screaming and fire swallowed the Dwarf, Vainaintress sent him to the demon realm to die... This was a mistake, as he never stopped fighting. He killed the lesser demons of the higher tier, and then worked his way deeper every moment, with nothing to lose and only the surge of power he felt with every demon killed, he continued his crusade alone, a guerilla campaign in hell fueled on hatred and fury. A few months after Moggron went missing, like threads suddenly being strung to a single point, every Dwarf on Lumenaria was presented with a choice. Follow Moggron The Demon-Smasher and fight back against demons, or be expelled from the Mountain. Moggron had amassed so much strength and power while in hell, he had achieved Demi god status at this point, on the cusp of being birthed as a racial god of Mountain Dwarfs, when the majority of Dwarf eagerly took the deal. it was all the catalyst he needed, the first and immediate change was less thirst for alcohol, fun or family, then came an utter disdain for anything not Mountain Dwarf, and a burning urge to kill EVERY demon. The latent connection between himself and his followers feeding strength into the newly evolved race of Mountain Dwarf, they would grow bigger, wider, their skin would harden to greys and blacks while becoming stony and tough. They would lose the ability to fear while under Moggron's influence, and could telepathically communicate with one another, in hundreds of years they would come to take on more demonic features such as horns and glowing red eyes that only burned brighter when fighting demons.

The Present: To this day, Moggron The Demon-Smasher, Racial God of Mountain Dwarf, is still fighting in hell, the overflow of power from his endless crusade fueling the Mountain Dwarf in the current Lumenaria times, he hasn't spoken in thousands of years, but it's rumored the current Forge Lord, can hear the mind of Moggron The Demon-Smasher.
entries.comment: Lumenaria Founder Being: Moggron The Demon-Smasher

entries.content:
Life on Lumenaria has long adapted to the presence of magic in one way or another, many times this manifests as abilities based on species or race. Every soul has an accumulated value that's strength is determined by their life experiences, on Lumenaria, those with strong will, whether due to inner strength, conviction or even down right psychopathy. The magic of the realm coalesces around those that DO, those that push and strive will find themselves constantly breaking their limits and improving their power, strength, knowledge.

When one soul lands the slaying blow on another, or a large portion of the Fated contributing wound, a portion of the soul is transferred from prey to predator. Killing is often the most straight forward way to gain power. Other ways forward is deep emotional turmoil, anguish, and overcoming those pains. Determination and positive displays of will power are no different, or even pure elation. Lumenaria feeds and fuels those that dare.

There are very rare mana diseases. The Mana flowing through Lumenaria is the natural deterrence to demonic incursion and intervention, mana doesn't impact demons, but the more powerful demons find it entirely impossible to establish a solid enough of a link to perform a teleport or portal opening due to the mana in everything acting as a signature scramble. Many mental and energy based demon powers become astronomically stronger in places with no mana or magical influence, as demonic energy is a Super-energy and cannot be nullified or canceled out independent from the latent magic of Lumenaria.
entries.comment: Lumenaria Concepts: Life, Mana, Souls, Power, XP and Determination.

entries.content:
Vulg Korgamundius is Eurudian renowned along side Balrung and his Death Brigade, legendary and terrifying. The Adventurer's Guild has put out an order to AVOID Vulg at ALL COST, giving him an SSS-Rank, all that stops him from being considered Z-Rank alongside Balrung is the fact that he's pure a melee combatant and cannot cause MASS death like dangerous Sorcerers or Assassins as such a high power level. Capable of taking on multiple S-Rank Adventurer's alone, Vulg powers through adversity with demi-human levels of conviction and cold, calculated rage. He has successfully fought off Rieka Whirlwind, a young, talented, and powerful S-Rank at full power. Vulg has killed exactly 6 S-Rank in the last year, the Guild is getting desprate for people to avoid Vulg while public facing but has ulterior motives in seeing how strong he can get. 

Combat Feats: Slayer of 6 S-Rank, Solo Kills(Manticore, Wyvern, Mountain Dwarf Weapons Master, Bedrock Golem), Led a team against a Hydra defeating it the old fashioned way WITHOUT fire, Caught A Cannon Ball Shot At Him By Captain Dora's Ship, Nearly Slapped The Life Out Of Drax For Teleporting Behind Him and Routed Rieka Whirlwind.

Ancient, eldritch creatures as old as the world itself, most if not all are dormant, the great storm barrier above providing a soothing blanket keeping the unfathomable lulled and insulated from the rest of Lumenaria, many consider these old gods, most consider it simply dabbling in darker mana like necromantic or chaos magic.

There are cults that dedicate themselves to dispelling the storm barrier to stir their 'gods' from slumber.

The only common physical denominator between Eud'Thuldian is that many of the old ones cannot be comprehended and will slay the viewer on sight. Instead they use pawns, lesser servants, and psychic projection to maintain connections and presence with mortal life, many of the servants who see their true form MUST be afflicted with madness to survive.

Notable Awoken: Dethr'Enda

A massive stretch of ocean leading northwards from the steep incline of Nyatika Plateau all the way to the desolate, frigid mana cap of the North Pole. This dangerous lane of storm is only navigable with special magic or during blind spots relative to the position of the moon and constellations above, to the west is Eurudia and to the East is the Darklands. Below this stretch, deep in the darkness of the ocean, are very peculiar and undiscovered biomasses and entities, such as the Eud'Thulian or elusive underwater kingdoms building up to make their presence known...
entries.comment: Naval Region: The Great Storm Barrier

entries.content: A huge well of blood deep in the crust of the earth, it is said that those that can commune and offer blood will find themselves with power and connections to powerful deities, those that partake can take from the well of power freely to fuel greater magic and cause all manner of chaos on the surface, the more one takes the larger the expectation of return becomes, but taking and giving both in return draws the ire of unfathomably power deities, an honor many covet, even some mortals. Being called to be a Champion of Blood by a powerful deity or demon is a dangerous offer to refuse, many choosing to be 'paid for their service' by never being called on again. Inherently all mortals have protection against these calls of service protected by holy higher power only lost in the face of severe and repeated, knowing lapses of mortality.

a Well of Power, a pressure point of mana, it's said they spawn out of legendary feats being achieved and have the power to shift the whole direction of Lumenaria, from building empires to pausing the flow of mana itself, to merely being a little taller,  the birth of a new species or the ascension of a current one, anything is possible with these focus points of mana and a strong willful adventurer to guide them. While there is no history of a great event spawning such points, it's widely accepted they do spawn naturally deep in the crust, and many recorded findings of minor wells of power have been used in the struggle between houses in Drowkin culture, the deep caverns underneath the Darklands, despite the danger from creatures, remains the easiest and fastest way of searching for such focal points. They manifest as a swilring arcane vortex on the ground, usually present for long periods of time before being discovered, the mana has eroded the terrain around them slowly as if water has worn away the surface. These are exceptionally rare and are considered by many to just be legend.

Other Names: Volt(Drowish), Siegkung(Mountain Dwarf), Godsfist(Orcish), Infinity(Eud'Thulian), Pride's Heart(Catikan)

Type:Monster
Encounter Sizes: Scout Party(4 Gekkan), Main Colony(36-2400 Gekkan, Average Colony Size 62 Gekkan)
Small Lizards That Fight In Tight Formations, Classes Like Knights, Mage(Cute Spells That Scale Up In Power With Numbers and Confidence), Lancers That Ride Bats, Archers, War Drummers and Music Troops, ect), There is always a King Gekkan to Many Queen Gekkan, The More Gekkan Under the Kings Control The Strong the Colonies Magic.
entries.comment: Lumenaria Special Monster: Variable Threat - Gekkan

entries.content:
The mana of Lumenaria is power and momentum by nature and must be directed somewhere, almost anything is possible with a skilled enough caster willing to risk their life experimenting.

There are spell pools and power applications for every element one could think of and some that are known only to very few or even singular individuals, the largest wealth of magical knowledge on Lumenaria is contained within the unshattered psyche Horatio, The First Demon and the unfathomable minds of the Elder Horror Eud'Thulians, neither of these accessible to Mortals. Many schools of magic have risen and even become forgotten to time and circumstance, that which isn't taught is sure to be forgotten.

Notes: Mountain Dwarf hunt sources of demonic influence when they can legally get away with it. Nercromancy is considered 100% normal as technically undead should always be tethered to their caster, this is so widely accepted most non-superstitious wouldn't think twice of a bone giant carrying groceries through the town square.

Summary of Drax's History: When Drax was young he was bullied for his House name sounding like it has a lisp, another Drowkin boy, a young Gallus of House Voidheart, stood up to Drax's bullies. To Gallus he would help anybody being picked on if he could, but to Drax he was his savior. And so Drax started keeping an eye on Gallus for years, always being too shy and timid to be forefront with his eventual feelings. Meanwhile, his mother, the Matriarch of House Deathpin, increasingly put more and more pressure on Drax to start planning for either her arranging dates or for himself to start dating. Everything culminated when on his 25th year of life, graduation day came, and by a cruel twist of fate, Drax's opponent was none other than Gallus of House Voidheart. Drax never stepped into the area, he ran, and he never stopped. Eventually taking a vessel all the way to Eurudia, unaware that his action cause the downfall of House Voidheart and Gallus' own exile. Drax lives in fear of DHA Kill Squads to this day, choosing to stay around Reacher's Hollow near other S-Rank Adventurers.
entries.comment: CHistory: Drax of House Deathpin (The Exiled Assassin)

entries.content:
First Bearer: Horatio Dredd was the result of the first possession, an evil sorcerer alive before 801 BGS, Carnifex blessed with a burning, unassailable soul, eventually grew too powerful in his conquest for Hortatio Dredd, the only one able to endure the mental pain of operating against his binding contract, Carnifex slew Horatio Dredd when he least suspected it while on the front line, ending the Alydian Empire's 799 year conquest of Eurudia one year before The Great Silence. Nobody knows Horatio Dredd used his deep well of mana in his mask to cause The Great Silence, finally releasing after a year, wiping out many natural magical entities in the wake, almost all of the undead based Alydian infrastructure with it.

Members of The Primordial Quarter when awakened from their sealed caskets will be able to SENSE Horatio's Mask being active in the mortal plain but cannot know where it or it's wearer is by design of their creation. Spoiler! A2/4, Horatio's First, Horatio Dredd, bearer, vessel, puppet

The massive frigid mountain in middle of The Darklands, the top is a trio of steeple spire tops, once home to the Moonkin whom is thought to be extinct after The Great Silence, below the base of the mountain underneath the surface is central Shadowreach Caverns, the home of the Drowkin and the Drowkin House Alliance. The Freehold Coalition refers to this mountain as Hoarwind Peak, while the Drowkin call it Darkspires. Wildlife here is surprisingly tame relative to the rest of the Darklands, but there are secrets hidden in this mountain laying to be discovered below the frost.

Description: Beneath the surface of The Darklands, there is a vast network of tunnels sprawling underneath the surface of nearly the whole continent, home to many of the most terrifying creatures on Lumenaria, the native denizens are extremely deadly, there are demons, hostile factions, and abominable horrors beyond comprehension. It is said that there are fonts of power deep in the crust of the earth, and these wells of mana are capable of forging the future, altering fate for everyone, or even creating new deities. Central deep underneath Hoarwind Peak, the Drowkin House Alliance has a sprawling condensed city consisting of houses and clans, all of Drowkin ancestry.

type: Underground Empire
Location: Under Hoarwind Peak In The Darklands
Societal Description: The Drowkin House Alliance, or DHA, consists of ancient "Houses" of Drowkin. Each house is ran by a Patriarch and Matriarch, culturally most houses are lead by the Matriarch, though some lead by the Patriarch do exist. Every Drowkin that is born to a house or clan is given to the DHA to undergo extreme training and education from a young age. The top 10% of performers rise to positions of Royalty and power while the other 90% are considered a Drone class to do the bidding of their respective houses they were born out of, all serving the monolithic central military enforcing peace between the plotting factions that make up the Drowkin House Alliance. Each house puts forward a representative, always their most dangerous combatant. On graduation day, at the age of 25, students duel each other to near death in unrestrained combat, those that are deemed to be holding back for emotional reasons are executed immediately. Those that survive get sorted into Royal and Drone classes based on their performance, grades and if they belong to a House, it is extremely difficult for those in clans to ascend into royalty, when it happens, it's due to exemplary combat performance in services of the DHA. The established, traditional Houses despise the formation of clans into new Houses, often sabotaging each others efforts to prevent such an occurrence.
Notable Houses: Terrorkin, 
Notable Clans: Deathpin(House Dismantled After Drax's Cowardice)
Destroyed Notable Houses and Clans: Voidheart
entries.comment: Underground Militaristic Empire: Drowkin House Alliance

entries.content: Summary of History From Gallus' Own Words: "Truthfully, it is a bad place to be for anybody but the strongest or those with the most political power. The Drow House Alliance is a Drow ethnostate constituting of many Houses and Clans. From birth children are taken from their parents and put through education and training, politics, subterfuge, combat, and eventually enforced military service until 25. The best are selected to be a part of the higher caste, the rest are a drone class. Any that don't meet standards are expelled into the Shadowreach Caverns, where the natural inhabitants of the caves are extremely lethal from the monsters, demons and other minor factions. The surface Darklands themselves I miss, and Little Hope, an exile refugee town, but the caverns and caves below? Barbaric." Gallus ends with spite for his old society.
entries.comment: CHistory: Gallus of (Destroyed) House Voidheart (The Benevolent Wanderer)

Homeland: South Nyatikan Sea
A species of aquatic sapient fish people, highly territorial, strong and cunning. They can walk on the surface indefinitely with any source of slightly salty water.
Physical Description: Skin(Pastel Colorful Skin Tones, Plump Hydrated Skin When Moisturized, Smooth, Rubbery, Very Strong), Female Aquillanox Have Fully Functioning Male Reproductive Organs, Earholes, Very Sensitive Fins On Head/Tail/Hips, Enlarged Forehead Containing The Melon(An Organ They Use To Sing Their War Songs In Ultrasound And Voice Both.), Reaches Full Physical Size Around 60 Years of Age, Standing On Average 6'9".
Social Info: Highly territorial they often fight and decide their life mates based on combat capability, there are some that abandon ocean life entirely to try and seek a more peaceful existence away from the hostile Lumenaria oceans.
Lifespan: Range 120-200 Natural Span, Average 90 Years Due To Battlelust And Territorial Tendencies.
The Call: Uses their Ultrasonic producing organ and voice to sing, providing a variety of buffs to allies and debuffs to enemies, to seduce, and more...
